title: Assessment of pharmacognostic specification of Cannabis sativa leaves in Thailand
publisher: Journal of Advanced Pharmaceutical Technology & Research
scope: Cannabis sativa mature-leaf macro- and microscopic anatomy, including epidermis, palisade and spongy mesophyll, midrib support tissues, vascular bundles, trichomes, and cystolith-bearing structures; used for structural anatomy rather than universal physiological thresholds.

title: Leaf Age and Position Effects on Quantum Yield and Photosynthetic Capacity in Hemp Crowns
scope: Cannabis sativa hemp leaf age, crown position, photosynthetic capacity, quantum yield, light saturation, respiration, electron transport, and the decline of photosynthetic performance after full leaf expansion in the studied cultivar and conditions.

title: Polyploidization for the Genetic Improvement of Cannabis sativa
scope: Cannabis sativa ploidy-associated differences in fan-leaf morphology, abaxial stomatal size and density, and related phenotype measurements; useful for showing that stomatal traits vary with genotype/ploidy rather than defining a universal species value.

title: Cannabis Yield, Potency, and Leaf Photosynthesis Respond Differently to Increasing Light Levels in an Indoor Environment
scope: Indoor Cannabis sativa leaf light-response curves across flowering, localized PPFD, temporal changes in photosynthetic capacity, and the limits of using a single leaf photosynthesis measurement as a stand-alone yield predictor.

title: Analysis of Morphological Traits, Cannabinoid Profiles, THCAS Gene Sequences, and Photosynthesis in Wide and Narrow Leaflet High-Cannabidiol Breeding Populations of Medical Cannabis
scope: Medical Cannabis breeding-population differences in leaflet morphology and measured gas-exchange/light-response traits, supporting genotype-aware interpretation of leaf form and photosynthetic measurements.
